name: Somchai Watanapan
bio:
Somchai's path to motorsport security was somewhat unconventional. After serving in the Royal Thai Army, where he developed a keen eye for detail and strategic planning, he transitioned into private security. A chance encounter providing security for a small racing event ignited his passion for the sport. He quickly recognized the unique challenges of motorsport security, from crowd control in high-energy environments to protecting valuable equipment and intellectual property. 

At Dick Johnson Racing, Somchai is responsible for the overall safety and security of the team's personnel, assets, and information. He meticulously plans security protocols for race events, manages a team of security personnel, and constantly evaluates potential threats. His perfectionist nature drives him to leave no stone unturned, ensuring the team operates in a safe and secure environment, allowing them to focus on performance. What sets Somchai apart is his calm and decisive leadership under pressure, a trait honed during his military service, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.description: Somchai is a muscular man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting any security concerns, no matter how minor.
Insists on performing a perimeter check of the garage area every morning before anyone else arrives.
Has a habit of cleaning his sunglasses with a microfiber cloth, even when they appear spotless.
